# dsh-nce
English · 简体中文

> A New Concept English Book 1 study panel that lives in the DeepSeek Harness
> sidebar: 144 lessons

on one scrollable page, Anki-style SRS flashcards, a mistake
> notebook, an IPA / phonics reference

, and fillable exercise papers graded by your
> own model. The host half serves `/dsh-nce/api`; the
browser half renders the panel.

> **The textbook data is not bundled** — this repository is code only. The lesson
> dataset is compi

led from copyrighted material and is excluded from git; see
> Textbook data is not bundled.
## Features
### Course browser

- Split view: a persistent 144-lesson list on the left and the selected lesson on the
right, with a

progress line (`已学 x / 144`), search, four lesson groups, a status
dropdown (not started / learning

/ done) and current-lesson highlight. Three step
dots per lesson (words / grammar / exercise) show w

here you stopped; the panel opens
on your last lesson or the next unfinished one and collapses to on
e column when narrow.
### One-page lesson

- Header (prev / next, number, English + Chinese title, counts, textbook pages, status)
plus a stick

y anchor bar that smooth-scrolls to `Video / Text / Words / Grammar /
Practice`. **Video** is collap

sed by default; expanding loads an embedded Bilibili
player mapped to the right part, and a custom B

ilibili / YouTube URL can be saved per
lesson with the built-in one restorable at any time.
- **Text

+ words** — two columns: question, dialogue lines (click a line or the speaker
to read it aloud) an

d collapsible reference translation on the left; a vocabulary
table with IPA, part of speech, meanin

g, read-aloud, and star-to-flashcards on the
right. Stacks automatically on narrow containers.
- **G

rammar** — textbook notes plus classroom-notes blocks; **Practice** — a per-lesson
homework checklis

t, a classroom recall card, and the fillable worksheet. The three
study steps are toggled from the s

tatus dropdown (choosing "done" checks all three)
or each section's "mark complete" switch.
### Fillable exercise papers

- Rendered from the textbook layout: blanks become inline inputs, matching questions
become real Col

umn A / B tables graded from the answer key, tabular questions become
tables, word boxes become bord

ered cards, and printed worked examples stay static.
`Enter` / `Shift+Enter` move between blanks; dr

afts autosave to `localStorage` per
lesson and survive lesson switches and a DSH restart.
- **One-cl

ick grading = AI teacher grades the whole paper.** Every answered question is
sent to the profile's

default model with the answer-key reference; the reply is
per-question `correct / close / wrong` plu

s a comment and reference answer, the score
is AI-correct / total, and every verdict can be overridd

en by hand. Without a default
model (or on failure) it degrades to deterministic system grading with

a header note.
- **Local PDF** — "Preview PDF" shows the real A4 pages and "Download PDF" generates

an
image-based PDF entirely in the browser (no network, no server, no print dialog).
### Requirements
| Requirement | Notes |
| DeepSeek Harness | Plugin manifest (`dsh.bundle` patch + `dsh.client`); developed and tested with

DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 and its `dsh web` / desktop web surface |
| Node.js | ≥ 20 on the machine running DSH

; the host uses `node:sqlite` and falls back to JSON when unavailable |
| macOS (optional) | `/usr/b

in/say` is the offline read-aloud fallback; other platforms use browser speech |
| dsh-translate (op

tional) | Adds the Edge neural voices and imports translation history as sentence cards |
| Textbook
dataset | **Not bundled** — build it yourself, see below |
## How it works

- **Host half.** `cordis.patch.yml` inserts one plugin row; `index.js` is a thin
composition root th

at wires `src/host/` (clean architecture: `domain` rules →
`application` use cases with injected por

ts → `infrastructure` SQLite/JSON/data/
speech/LLM adapters → `http` transport) and mounts `POST /ds

h-nce/api/<op>` on the
host web server.
- **Browser half.** `client.js` is generated from `src/clien

t/NN-*.js` fragments by
`scripts/build-client.mjs`; fragments are concatenated in ascending two-digi

t layer
order and may only reference earlier layers. React and the host theme come from the
DSH modu

le table.
- **API and storage.** JSON in / JSON out (`{ ok: true, ... }` or `{ ok: false, error }`)

behind a loopback `Host` fence. Lesson status, SRS cards, streak, and saved video URLs
live in SQLit

e (`node:sqlite`, WAL) with a JSON fallback; paper drafts, homework,
mistakes, and UI preferences li

ve in browser `localStorage`. AI grading uses the
profile's default model through the host LLM gatew
ay; no API key is stored.

Deeper contracts: PLUGIN-ARCH ·
API-CONTRACT · PERSISTENCE ·
LEARNING-FLOW · EXERCISE-PAPER ·
DATA-C
ONTRACT · DATA-QUALITY.
## Data & privacy
| What | Where |
| Learning progress (status, SRS, streak, video URLs) | `~/.dsh/dsh-nce/nce.sqlite` (+ `-wal` / `-sh

m`), legacy `~/.dsh/dsh-nce/progress.json` |
| Paper drafts / homework ticks / mistakes / UI state |
`localStorage` → `dsh-nce/paper/v1/lesson-<n>`, `dsh-nce/homework/v1/lesson-<n>`, `dsh-nce/mistakes

/v1`, `dsh-nce/nav|scroll|ui|prefs/v1/*` |
| Read-aloud cache / translation history (read-only) | `~
/.dsh/dsh-translate/tts-cache/` (or `~/.dsh/dsh-nce/tts-cache/`), `~/.dsh/dsh-translate/history.json

` |
| Course content | The plugin's `data/` directory, read-only; **not published in this repo** |

Nothing is uploaded by default: progress, drafts, and the mistake notebook stay on the
local machine

. Data leaves it only for features that need the network — the Bilibili
video embed, Microsoft Edge

voices, and AI grading (sent to the model configured in
your DSH profile). The repository ships no l
esson dataset and no personal data.
## Compatibility

- macOS, Windows, and Linux for the panel itself (a browser surface inside DSH); the
`say` read-alou

d fallback is macOS-only, other platforms fall back to browser speech.
- Built against the DSH plugi

n manifest used by `dsh 0.2.x`; a change to that manifest
or to the client module table could requir

e a plugin update. The textbook dataset is
bring-your-own and platform-independent once built.
